clue.text: Mechanical widget? Pair fitting into hollow

explanation.definitionFit: A sprocket is a toothed wheel engaging a chain, a small mechanical component, hence a widget in jest.

clue.text: Criss-cross pattern in thin strip on gilded leather

clue.text: The breath of life was going in the old man

clue.text: Oldest cargo going off in refrigeration (11, two words)

clue.text: Doctor kept in like this reads intensively

clue.text: Wing a crane's seen to flap and fly around

clue.text: Like a nihilist, rarely over-obsessive about architecture

clue.text: High tone on being released tremolo in octave

clue.text: James, or Jim?

clue.text: Sailors' song in the can almost, with arrangement

clue.text: What's hooked or what's netted by us, mass in hold

clue.text: King having correspondence with clergy (not RC) – 'e offers help for those on the rocks
